mapper.select: select count(*) from log_analysis_detail d inner join log_analysis_task t on d.task_id = t.task_id where t.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.severity), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM log_analysis_detail d INNER JOIN log_analysis_task t ON d.task_id = t.task_id WHERE t.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND d.is_anomaly = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.severity), ''), 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
FROM log_analysis_detail d INNER JOIN log_analysis_task t ON d.task_id = t.task_id WHERE t.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
AND UPPER(d.severity) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{severity}), '%')
AND d.desensitized_log LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND d.is_anomaly = 1
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
